modules.title: Module 01 · Intention
modules.summary: Define purpose, values, and foundational identity for regenerative business development.
modules.objective: Participants complete core self-discovery assessments and map personal mission to business goals.
lesson_points: Complete role assessment and identify natural leadership posture.
Build a passion compass aligned to work and service goals.
Prioritize values with practical application in business decisions.
Draft a concise origin story and personal identity statement.
